I am an old man of 76 years here in Mbeya, and maize is our life in these Southern Highlands. I have been farming this small plot for many years, so I know it needs fertilizer to give a good harvest — I will buy one bag of DAP or CAN if the price allows, and put a little manure from my goats too. I cannot manage heavy work anymore, so my children and grandchildren help with the family labor, and I will hire a few people for weeding and harvesting. I will plant improved maize seed because here in Mbeya it yields better, but I cannot afford to irrigate or spray pesticides on maize.
